title: Canal building era
detail: Starts with the Erie Canal (built 1817 to 1825); state-financed canal building spread until the railways took over, and several states defaulted on canal debts in the early 1840s.

title: Railroad building boom
detail: Track grew from a few dozen miles in 1830 to about 170,000 by 1893; repeated booms and busts (the panics of 1857, 1873 and 1893 all followed railway overbuilding).

title: Electrification
detail: Power stations, grids and factory re-equipment; rural electrification followed from 1935.

title: Interstate Highway System
detail: Authorised by the Federal-Aid Highway Act of 29 June 1956; the original system was declared complete in 1992.

title: Telecom and dot-com investment boom
detail: Fibre networks and internet companies; the Nasdaq peaked on 10 March 2000 and much of the fibre laid stayed unused for years.

title: Shale oil and gas boom
detail: Horizontal drilling and fracking; US oil output nearly doubled before the 2014 price fall.

title: AI data-centre build-out
detail: Data centres, chips and power for AI; still under way.

title: Japanese asset price bubble
detail: Land and share prices; the Nikkei peaked on 29 December 1989, followed by the 'lost decade'.

title: US housing bubble and financial crisis
detail: House prices peaked in 2006; Lehman Brothers failed on 15 September 2008; the recession ran from December 2007 to June 2009.

title: Post-2008 investment and infrastructure push
detail: A stimulus programme announced on 9 November 2008, then years of high investment in railways, roads and housing.
